assertions.assertion: Program.cs configures OpenIdConnectEvents on the OIDC handler
assertions.rationale: options.Events = new OpenIdConnectEvents { ... } is configured on the OIDC handler.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs sets OnRedirectToIdentityProvider to add AcrValues = 'tenant:myorg' to the ProtocolMessage
Program.cs sets OnRemoteFailure to call context.HandleResponse() and redirect to /auth-error
assertions.rationale: OnRemoteFailure calls context.HandleResponse() and redirects to /auth-error.

assertions.rationale: It sets context.ProtocolMessage.LoginHint = email inside OnRedirectToIdentityProvider.
